Counted rhythm: composition:"phrase", phrase:{strokes:[{bottom_percent,top_percent,count,rate_percent},...]}. These are absolute slider turning positions: bottom is the lower/deeper turnaround, top the upper/shallower turnaround. Each group contributes count lower/upper turn pairs, in order; the whole phrase repeats. Adjacent pairs join directly without resets or added pauses. Keep at least10 points between each bottom and both adjacent tops. Choose1..6 groups, count1..8 each, total<=24. rate_percent1..100 scales base travel rate (100 preserves it). Each ascent uses its group's rate. A shared descent uses the narrowest adjacent group containing that whole leg; ties or neither-containing use the destination group. Thus a full sweep's outbound and return both use its rate, whether anchored at the base or tip. Choose regional coverage for the request, without a fixed tip width. A complete device sweep uses bottom0/top100, regardless of the preceding band's endpoints. Phrase replaces range/center layers and derives its band from the chosen turns. Previously copied pace timing becomes independent; phrase pace supports edit/remove, never follow. Returning to field motion keeps a shared base/tip anchor when one exists; otherwise the prior anchor remains. Counts and reach do not specify pace. Shorter travel already produces more strokes at the same travel rate; do not raise speed to make a counted group quicker. For a count/reach-only edit, omit controls, layers and evolve, and retain existing per-group rates when editing a phrase. Repetition means the ordered groups recur; it does not mean removing seeded pace variation. memory_cycles controls variation development, never the number of strokes in a motif. Independent pace changes remain available through speed_percent,memory_cycles,pace_variation_percent and the pace layer when requested or when autonomous pacing is permitted. Independent pace-control/layer edits retain an existing phrase. Geometry/stroke_width/shape-control/range-or-center-layer edits return to field motion, replacing the phrase. Evolve changes seeded pace detail only. Use field motion for uncounted wandering; do not substitute it for requested counts. Keeping the exact motion means no edits: its internal variation already repeats.
